On-premise LLM/Agent/RAG deployment — technical mentor (hourly, ongoing) - DevOps & Solution Architecture

Experience level: Expert | Pricing type: hourly | Duration: 3 to 6 months | Hours per week: 30 hrs/week

Summary

Swiss IT services company (est. 1996, ~10 people), clients in legal and finance. We're building on-premise AI servers for our clients: open-source models, RAG over internal documents and email, full data sovereignty — nothing leaves the building.
We handle servers, networks and security ourselves. We need someone who has already run this stack in production and can tell us what breaks, not someone building a POC with us.
What you'd do:

- Hardware/software sizing with precise, justified recommendations: GPU and VRAM, Ollama vs vLLM,
Open WebUI configuration, vector DB, ingestion pipeline — not a generic opinion, but numbers and choices we can apply directly
- Hardware sizing for on-prem installs at client sites: GPU/VRAM, CPU/RAM balance, storage, rack vs tower, power/cooling in small server rooms
- RAG quality in French (non-English)
- Access control / multi-user setup
- Maintenance, model updates, monitoring over time
- 1-2 video calls/week to start, screen-sharing on real deployments, plus async questions by email.

Terms: hourly, ongoing, long-term if it works.
To apply, answer these three questions — no cover letter, no deck:

- One on-premise LLM/RAG deployment you took to production: team size, stack, hardware, what went wrong. Include something verifiable — reference, case study, repo, or other concrete proof.
- For a 20-user deployment on 1-2 GPUs: which GPU/VRAM, CPU/RAM, and inference server would you use, and why?
- Your availability for recurring calls (we're CET).

Applications without a verifiable deployment example will not be considered.

Image-to-Vector Conversion – Machine Learning AI Model - AI & Machine Learning

Experience level: Entry level | Pricing type: Fixed-price

Summary

***INTRO***
I have been running an online vectorization service for around 10 years. During that time, I have accumulated gigabytes of training data. Basically, I have low-quality raster input images paired with high-quality, manually vectorized outputs. Someone mentioned that this kind of dataset could be very valuable for machine learning. This could help create a high-quality vectorization app that would sell very well.

***APP DEVELOPMENT***
I’m not sure if AI can build a vectorization app from scratch, but there are some decent free open-source vectorization apps available (POTRACE, VTRACER). AI could take them to the next level, significantly increasing the value of software like that.

I'm not sure if AI machine learning can be incorporated into existing apps. 

***AI MODEL***
I still do vectorization, so the AI model could continue learning from me.

***MARKETING***
1. I have an email database of thousands of people and companies that have previously been interested in vectorization (A lot of them were/are paying customers)
2. I also do SEO and internet marketing, and I'm ready to invest in paid advertising.

***COOPERATION***
I am considering two pricing models. Let me know in your message which one would work best for you.

1. Either I would pay for the entire app development.
2. Or we could share the profits from future sales. The code of the developed app would stay on your server, and I would pay a monthly fee for API usage.  Even in this case, I could pay an upfront bonus. I think it is a good investment because it can generate income without requiring to work.

***INFORMATION I WOULD LIKE TO GET***
1. How would you handle this project? What approach would you take regarding the coding and AI/machine learning aspects?
2. Which payment model are you interested in?
3. How quickly could you create a usable vectorization app?
4. If you would like to choose the API option, what type of server do you have, and would you be able to run it efficiently 24/7 without long processing times?

Skills: Python, AI Model Development, AI Model Training, AI Model Integration, Machine Learning, Rust, Deep Learning, AI coding

Technical Co-Founder / Software Developer Wanted for Sports Tech Startup - Web Development

Experience level: expert | Pricing type: Hourly | Duration: 1 to 3 months | Hours per week: 30 hrs/week

Summary

Hi, we're looking for a talented software developer to join Marcr, an early-stage sports technology startup based in Australia. For the right person, this role has the opportunity to eventually develop into a permanent Technical Co-Founder position, with the chance to help shape the technology, product and future direction of the company. More information at www.marcrtech.io 

Marcr is being built to turn everyday football training into measurable performance data. The vision is to use computer vision, video analysis and intelligent movement tracking to analyse athletes completing real-world training drills and provide practical feedback on speed, agility, movement and performance.

We have already begun validating the concept with athletes and football clubs and are now looking for the right technical person to help build the technology and shape the product from the ground up.

We are looking for someone who sees the opportunity in what we are building, has a genuine passion for improving technology in football training and to potentially become part of the company as a co-founder, with long-term involvement in Marcr.

The ideal person would have experience or a strong interest in areas such as:

• Mobile app development
• Computer vision and video analysis
• AI and machine learning
• Human movement or pose tracking
• iOS and Android development
• Building and launching early-stage products

You do not need to be an expert in every area. More important is having strong technical ability, curiosity, and the drive to build something from an early stage.

You would work directly with our team to determine the technical direction of Marcr, build the first scalable version of the platform, test it with real athletes and clubs, and help shape the company as we grow.

If you are a developer who has wanted to build a product for athletes we would love to have a conversation.

Please tell me a little about your background, what you have built before, and why joining an early-stage sports technology company interests you.

Skills: AI Development, Web Development, JavaScript, Artificial Intelligence, Android App Development, iOS Development, Mobile App Development, CV

Machine Learning Model for Bio-Oil Yield Prediction from Biomass Feedstocks - AI & Machine Learning

Experience level: Entry level | Pricing type: Fixed-price

Summary

I want to develop a machine learning models to accurately predict bio-oil yield obtained from biomass pyrolysis using the physical and chemical characteristics of biomass feedstocks.

The objective is to build a regression model capable of estimating the conversion efficiency of different biomass materials such as agricultural residues, wood waste, and other renewable feedstocks.

The project includes:

Data preprocessing and cleaning
Feature engineering
Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)
Regression model development
Model comparison (Random Forest, XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost, Neural Networks)
Hyperparameter optimization
Performance evaluation (RMSE, MAE, R²)
Feature importance analysis using SHAP
Prediction for new biomass samples
Clear documentation and visualization of results

The final deliverables include a trained machine learning model, reproducible Python code, evaluation report, and prediction interface if required.

Building AI Assistance Model System - AI & Machine Learning

Experience level: Entry level | Pricing type: hourly

Summary

[PRICE IS A PLACEHOLDER]

Build a Unified Local AI Assistant Platform

I am looking for someone to build a complete desktop application that allows me to run multiple specialized AI models through one clean, easy-to-use interface.

The goal is for the entire system to behave like separate AI with 3D AI faces and voices as multiple specialists working together behind the scenes.

Each AI should have its own icon that I can click to speak directly with that specialist.

Additionally, there should be one Master Launch icon that starts the entire system at once and allows all of the AI models to work together collaboratively.

The finished application should require as little manual setup as possible after installation.

AI Models

The system will use the following models:

Qwen3-Coder
Fin-R1
Hermes-4
FLUX.1-dev
Magnum V4
Qwen3-235B
Kimi K2.5

Large models may run through hourly cloud GPU services while lighter models may run locally if appropriate.

Unified AI System

Although each model has its own specialty, I do not want them functioning like completely separate applications.

Instead, I want one interconnected system where:

Every model can communicate with one another.
The models can pass tasks between themselves.
One model can request assistance from another.
Shared memory can be accessed when appropriate.
Specialized memories can remain private to individual models when needed.

For example:

The writing model can ask the coding model for code.
The research model can provide information to the writing model.
The finance model can analyze financial data generated elsewhere.
The image model can generate artwork requested during conversations.

Everything should feel like one AI made up of multiple specialists.

Interface

The application should have a clean desktop interface.

I would like:

One Master Launch icon that starts the complete system.
Individual icons for every AI model.
Ability to switch between specialists instantly.
Status indicators showing whether each model is online.
Simple settings menu.
Characters

Each AI should have:

Its own avatar or face.
Its own voice.
Separate personality and system prompt.
NVIDIA Audio2Face lip syncing if possible.
Chatterbox TTS voices.
Speech recognition for talking naturally with the AI.
Voice Features

Required features:

Voice recognition (speech-to-text)
Natural text-to-speech
Push-to-talk
Optional wake word if practical
Real-time conversations
Ability to interrupt speech naturally
Memory

Use:

PostgreSQL
ChromaDB

The system should support:

Long-term memory
Conversation history
Shared memories
Individual memories
Searchable memories
Controller

Python is preferred for the backend.

Responsibilities include:

Starting every service
Routing prompts
Managing memory
Coordinating the AI models
Cloud GPU communication
WebSocket communication
Voice processing
Launching and monitoring the entire system
Hardware

Primary computer:

ASUS ROG Ally

Storage:

External 1–4 TB SSD

The application should be configured to load models from the external SSD whenever possible.

Cloud GPU Support

The system should support hourly cloud GPU services for the larger models.

The local interface should remain responsive while the heavy AI models run remotely.

If possible, cloud providers should be easy to change later without rebuilding the application.

Installation Requirements

One of the most important deliverables is a complete installation process.

I would like:

A step-by-step installation guide written for someone with limited programming experience.
Instructions for downloading every required model.
Instructions for organizing the models on the external SSD.
Instructions for installing every dependency.
Instructions for configuring cloud GPU services.
Instructions for setting up PostgreSQL.
Instructions for setting up ChromaDB.
Instructions for installing Python and required packages.
Instructions for configuring WebSockets.
Instructions for connecting Chatterbox TTS.
Instructions for connecting NVIDIA Audio2Face.
Instructions for changing voices later.
Instructions for replacing avatars later.
Instructions for replacing AI models later.
Instructions for updating the system in the future.

The goal is that I can completely rebuild the system later using only the documentation provided.

Ease of Use

The finished application should feel like a polished desktop application rather than a collection of scripts.

Ideally I should be able to:

Double-click one icon.
Wait for everything to load automatically.
Begin talking to the AI immediately.

No manual terminal commands should be required during normal use.

Deliverables
Complete source code
Full documentation
Installer or setup package if possible
Configuration files
Step-by-step installation guide
Model installation guide
Cloud GPU setup guide
External SSD setup guide
Future update instructions
Instructions for adding new AI models
Instructions for replacing existing models
Instructions for changing personalities
Instructions for changing voices
Instructions for replacing avatars

Please tell me how you would build the project, which technologies you recommend, your estimated timeline, and examples of similar work if available.

Skills: Machine Learning, Python, TensorFlow, Data Science, Deep Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Natural Language Processing, Neural Network, Keras, Computer Vision
